openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional idempotency key. When a create is retried with a key that
            has already been seen, the originally created owner is returned with
            200 instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create was retried with an already-seen idempotency key; the
            originally created owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          description: Owner  not found.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or
            'DR'). When supplied it is used to compose the read-only
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' (with optional 'addressLine2') is supplied it is
            preferred, and this field is returned as the composed value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same
            way (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Apt 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the read-only 'ageBand', the owner's age band computed
            against the registrationDate. Stored and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. Owners with the same lastName and postcode belong to
            the same household (they share a deterministic householdId). Setting this
            flag true admits the owner as a declared household member, which is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate even when it soft-matches an existing
            household member. Duplicate detection is keyed on the identity key, so a
            second household member with a different telephone is admitted as a soft
            match rather than rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the identifiers derived for the owner,
        grouped together. Every identifier mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so
        it differs from the value the owner would have carried under version 1.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
            where REGION is the version-2 region embedded inside the owner's
            identifiers (the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode,
            falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN', with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year that contains
            the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year
            starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hexadecimal
            characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalised telephone
            concatenated with its lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2279F86D0817'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, derived
            deterministically as the first 12 lower-case hexadecimal characters
            of the SHA-256 digest of the fixed 'V2' version tag, the owner's
            normalised lastName and its postcode, all '|'-separated. Owners with
            the same lastName and postcode therefore resolve to the same
            householdId.
          type: string
          example: '9e107d9d372b'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            A derived key used for duplicate detection: the 64-character
            lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 digest over the fixed 'V2' version
            tag, the owner's normalised telephone, its lower-cased email (or
            empty) and the Soundex code of its lastName, all '|'-separated. A
            create whose identity key matches an existing, non-deleted owner is
            rejected with 409 Conflict. Because the telephone is part of the key,
            two owners with the same lastName and postcode but different
            telephones have different keys and are not a hard duplicate.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is
                present, or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans: a
                leading '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner representation's API version. Always 2 for the
                version-2 owner identity.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: its memberId, householdId and
                identityKey grouped together.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year that contains its
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate from July to December falls in the next calendar
                year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a non-negative score derived from
                its factors: starting at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more
                (householdSize) and add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds a year
                (at least one whole fiscal year elapsed since its registrationDate).
                A newly created owner never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, mapped from its
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3
                for 4-5 and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, read from the '<REGION>' component
                of its memberId (the region derived from the owner's postcode,
                falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from its locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over, with age computed against the registrationDate.
                Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the capacity limit of 50 owners: 'true' when the
                city already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key used for duplicate detection: the 64-character
                lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalised
                telephone, a '|', its lower-cased email (or empty), a '|' and the
                Soundex code of its lastName, i.e.
                SHA-256('normalizedTelephone|<lowerEmail or empty>|soundex(lastName)').
                A create whose identity key matches an existing, non-deleted owner
                is rejected with 409 Conflict. Because the telephone is part of the
                key, two owners with the same lastName and postcode but different
                telephones have different keys and are not a hard duplicate.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was a soft match
                for an existing owner: its identity key differs from that owner's
                (so it is not a hard duplicate) yet the Soundex of their lastNames
                and their postcodes match. 'true' when such a match exists,
                otherwise 'false'. A declared household member (admitted via
                'sharesHousehold') is never flagged: it is not a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation
                (differing identity key but matching Soundex of lastName and
                postcode), or absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner is flagged as risky: 'true' when any risk
                signal holds — it is a possible duplicate, its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (on the disposable-domain blocklist), or its
                city was over its soft capacity at creation (capacityWarning) —
                otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                'false'; deleting the owner via DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it to
                'true' while retaining the record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional idempotency key. When a create is retried with a key that
            has already been seen, the originally created owner is returned with
            200 instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create was retried with an already-seen idempotency key; the
            originally created owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or
            'DR'). When supplied it is used to compose the read-only
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' (with optional 'addressLine2') is supplied it is
            preferred, and this field is returned as the composed value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same
            way (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Apt 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the read-only 'ageBand', the owner's age band computed
            against the registrationDate. Stored and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. Owners with the same lastName and postcode belong to
            the same household (they share a deterministic householdId). Setting this
            flag true admits the owner as a declared household member, which is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate even when it soft-matches an existing
            household member. Duplicate detection is keyed on the identity key, so a
            second household member with a different telephone is admitted as a soft
            match rather than rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the identifiers derived for the owner,
        grouped together. Every identifier mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so
        it differs from the value the owner would have carried under version 1.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
            where REGION is the version-2 region embedded inside the owner's
            identifiers (the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode,
            falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN', with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year that contains
            the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year
            starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hexadecimal
            characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalised telephone
            concatenated with its lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2279F86D0817'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, derived
            deterministically as the first 12 lower-case hexadecimal characters
            of the SHA-256 digest of the fixed 'V2' version tag, the owner's
            normalised lastName and its postcode, all '|'-separated. Owners with
            the same lastName and postcode therefore resolve to the same
            householdId.
          type: string
          example: '9e107d9d372b'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            A derived key used for duplicate detection: the 64-character
            lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 digest over the fixed 'V2' version
            tag, the owner's normalised telephone, its lower-cased email (or
            empty) and the Soundex code of its lastName, all '|'-separated. A
            create whose identity key matches an existing, non-deleted owner is
            rejected with 409 Conflict. Because the telephone is part of the key,
            two owners with the same lastName and postcode but different
            telephones have different keys and are not a hard duplicate.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is
                present, or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans: a
                leading '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner representation's API version. Always 2 for the
                version-2 owner identity.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: its memberId, householdId and
                identityKey grouped together.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year that contains its
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate from July to December falls in the next calendar
                year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a non-negative score derived from
                its factors: starting at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more
                (householdSize) and add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds a year
                (at least one whole fiscal year elapsed since its registrationDate).
                A newly created owner never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, mapped from its
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3
                for 4-5 and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, read from the '<REGION>' component
                of its memberId (the region derived from the owner's postcode,
                falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from its locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over, with age computed against the registrationDate.
                Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the capacity limit of 50 owners: 'true' when the
                city already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was a soft match
                for an existing owner: its identity key differs from that owner's
                (so it is not a hard duplicate) yet the Soundex of their lastNames
                and their postcodes match. 'true' when such a match exists,
                otherwise 'false'. A declared household member (admitted via
                'sharesHousehold') is never flagged: it is not a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation
                (differing identity key but matching Soundex of lastName and
                postcode), or absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner is flagged as risky: 'true' when any risk
                signal holds — it is a possible duplicate, its email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (on the disposable-domain blocklist), or its
                city was over its soft capacity at creation (capacityWarning) —
                otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                'false'; deleting the owner via DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it to
                'true' while retaining the record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

    PetFields:

    Pet:

    VetFields:

## What I changed

**Version-2 identity derivation** (`OwnerDerivations.java`) — added a fixed `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` mixed into every identifier so all values differ from v1 and none recur:
- `identifierRegion` → `region(...) + "V2"`, so `memberId`'s embedded region (and its Luhn check digit) changes.
- `identityKey` → `SHA-256("V2|" + tel + "|" + mail + "|" + soundex(lastName))`.
- `householdId` → `SHA-256("V2|" + lastName + "|" + postcode)`.
- `locality` now derives the plain region straight from the owner's fields (`postcode`/`city`) instead of parsing it back out of the (now-tagged) `memberId`; removed the obsolete `memberIdRegion` helper. `timezone` and the owner-segment area stay on this plain region, so the `V2` tag never leaks into user-facing fields. Updated `Owner.getLocality()` to the new 2-arg signature.

**Response shape** (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper`):
- Added an `OwnerIdentity` schema (`memberId`, `householdId`, `identityKey`) and moved those three off the top-level `Owner` into a nested `identity` object.
- Added a top-level `apiVersion` integer (constant `2` via MapStruct).
- Mapper builds `identity.*` from the owner and sets `apiVersion`, with matching reverse mappings.

**Audit event** (`OwnerCreationAuditor`) — bumped to schema v2: added `"schemaVersion": 2` and the `ownerSegment` recomputed from the v2 identity; the reported `memberId` is now the v2 value automatically.

The provided `AcceptanceTest` (verifying `$.apiVersion == 2`, the nested `$.identity.*` fields, and absence of the old top-level fields) passes, and the full suite is green.
